title: filaginella uliginosa subsp. rossica
intro: Filaginella uliginosa subsp. rossica, commonly known as the Russian filaginella, is a subspecies of the Filaginella uliginosa plant, which is a type of succulent plant belonging to the ice plant family (Aizoaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Filaginella uliginosa subsp. rossica include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help in treating various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may have potential applications in the development of new pharmaceuticals.
